options: A. Criminal cases are decided by flipping a coin in municipal court, whereas civil cases are tried only before international military tribunals.
B. In a civil lawsuit the defendant is sentenced to twenty years in state prison, whereas in a criminal felony trial the only penalty is a written apology.

D.
